mapper.select: SELECT m.SECID secid, f.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, m.VALUE_SOURCE, m.CDATE cdate, m.MDPRICE mdprice, m.MCPRICE mcprice, m.MINT mint, m.MYIELD*100 myield, m.M_MDURATION mMduration, m.M_CNVXTY mCnvxty, m.ISSUE_MARKET_NUM issueMarketNum, m.CREDIT_TYPE creditType FROM MST_CREDIT_MARKET_INFO m LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT f ON f.FINPROD_ID=m.SECID LEFT JOIN INTERF_CREDITINFO i ON i.SECID = m.SECID AND m.SECID=#{secId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND m.CDATE=to_date(#{valueDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND m.VALUE_SOURCE=#{valueSource,jdbcType=DATE}
